settings.editor: Have a question about communication, a team situation, or which PCM format might suit you? Tell me a little about it. We can find a useful starting point together.
Ask your questions, tell me what is happening, and get a sense of how I work. We can decide together whether a consultation, workshop or training is a useful next step.
Tell me what brought you here, whether you are asking for yourself or a group, and what you would like to understand or change. A few lines are enough.
I work in English, Estonian and Russian. Individual conversations can take place online or in Tallinn. For teams and groups, I also come on site across Estonia.
If you are not sure which format fits, you can look at consultations and PCM trainings, or simply write to me. We can decide where to start together.
